reason: A DeepSeek Harness Web interface plugin centered on a multi-character Galgame experience, with a desktop pet, persistent relationship context, optional web research, and optional DashScope image generation.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供带多角色对话、好感度记忆、剧情互动和可选桌宠的 Galgame 体验。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness Web plugin that provides a multi-character Galgame experience with relationship memory, interactive stories, and an optional desktop pet.

capabilities: Provides a multi-character Galgame conversation interface
Displays an optional desktop pet and customizable visual assets
Persists cross-session character state, conversation history, relationship progress, and task-event metadata
Sends conversations to the selected model provider
Can perform web searches for configured theater content
Can send image-generation prompts to DashScope for optional CG generation
Reads recent Harness task events and reduces them to fixed categories and status cues
